post.description: Create a new product (Creator only). Product will be created as unpublished by default.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific product by ID

put.description: Update an existing product. Only the creator who owns the product can update it.

message.example: You are not authorized to perform this action on this product.

delete.description: Delete a product. Only the creator who owns the product can delete it. Product must not have any purchases.

message.example: You are not authorized to perform this action on this product.
Product cannot be deleted because it has purchases.

post.description: Publish a product to make it active and available for purchase. Only the creator who owns the product can publish it. Product must have both an image and a file.

403.description: Forbidden - Not the product owner or Creator role required

message.example: You are not authorized to perform this action on this product.
Product must have both a file and an image before publishing.

post.description: Unpublish a product to make it inactive and unavailable for purchase. Only the creator who owns the product can unpublish it.

403.description: Forbidden - Not the product owner or Creator role required

message.example: You are not authorized to perform this action on this product.
